description.en: Repeated divided frond-like systems are arranged around an upright axis.
description.zh: 反复分裂的蕨状枝系围绕直立轴排列。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Rhacophyton ceratangium; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Rhacophyton ceratangium 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Three-dimensional frond frameworks replace the broad pinnate leaf blades of the existing fern cluster.
distinctness.zh: 立体蕨状枝架区别于现有蕨丛的宽羽状叶片。

modeling_brief.en: Keep terminal divisions as open branchlets; use a spiral scaffold without inventing modern leaf blades.
modeling_brief.zh: 把末级分裂保留为空透细枝，采用螺旋支架，不添加现代叶片。

assets.uncertainty: Historical reconstruction; relationship to true ferns and exact whole-plant habit require care.

sources.supports: Rhacophyton and Archaeopteris flora and habitat evidence.

description.en: A columnar lycopsid trunk has vertical rows of leaf scars and a comparatively compact leafy crown.
description.zh: 柱状石松类树干具纵向叶痕列及较集中的叶冠。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Sigillaria; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Sigillaria 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Vertical rib-and-scar columns and limited crown division contrast with the existing Lepidodendron diamond cushions and high repeated forks.
distinctness.zh: 纵肋叶痕列及有限分叉树冠区别于现有鳞木的菱形叶枕和多级高叉。

modeling_brief.en: Use broad vertical trunk ribs and long crown straps; select one documented branching habit instead of mixing species.
modeling_brief.zh: 用宽纵肋和长带状冠叶建形，采用单一已记录分枝型，不混合不同种。

assets.uncertainty: Sigillaria habits vary; selected ribbed form is a genus-level planning concept.

description.en: A branching sphenopsid bears conspicuously divided leaves at nodes.
description.zh: 分枝木贼类植物在节部着生显著深裂叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Pseudobornia ursina; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Pseudobornia ursina 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Laciniate broad leaf divisions and branching framework differ from the existing horsetail's thin needle whorls.
distinctness.zh: 宽叶深裂片及分枝骨架区别于现有木贼细针状轮生枝。

modeling_brief.en: Model the large branch scaffold and nodal leaf fans first; use the recent reappraisal for fertile structures.
modeling_brief.zh: 先建立粗枝架和节部叶扇，育性结构依据近期重审研究。

assets.uncertainty: Total tree outline remains less secure than detached branching systems.

sources.supports: Devonian branching sphenopsid with deeply divided leaves and fertile structures.

description.en: A woody jointed trunk supports nodal branch tiers and small whorled foliage.
description.zh: 木质分节树干支撑节生分层枝和小型轮生叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Calamites; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Calamites 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: A substantial woody trunk and secondary branch hierarchy distinguish it from the existing seven-stem herbaceous horsetail cluster.
distinctness.zh: 粗木质树干及次级分枝层次区别于现有七茎草本木贼丛。

modeling_brief.en: Use a continuous trunk with conspicuous nodes and offset branch rings; do not turn pith-cast ribs into asserted bark.
modeling_brief.zh: 用连续主干、明显节环和错位枝轮建形，不把髓腔铸型肋直接当作树皮。
